deps.notes: Pipfile pins flask-sqlalchemy==2.5.1 + sqlalchemy==1.4.3 (Py3.8 era) which break on Python 3.11+/Flask 3 (import _app_ctx_stack, marshmallow 4, connexion flask extra). Baseline reproduced with flask-sqlalchemy 3.1.1 + marshmallow 4.3.0 + connexion 3.3.0 + flask 3.1.3 on Python 3.13. Seed script scripts/repro_seed.py wraps app_context; repo's build_database.py targets 2.x and fails on 3.x. This dependency drift is captured in retro.
